ELECTION OF OFFICERS
1.
Election of New Chairperson and Vice Chairperson. Recommendation: Elect by majority vote a new Chairperson and Vice Chairperson to serve as officers of the Utility Board.
A-1. Election of Officers
A-1. Ord01-07

C.
UTILITIES DIRECTOR COMMENTS
D.
UTILITY BOARD MEMBER COMMENTS
E.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
Minutes. Recommendation: Approve minutes of regular meeting on January 24, 2011 as written.
E-1. UB Min Jan-11
2.
Project W-266A Water Main Replacement Contract. Recommendation: Approve the award of contract to C.P. Construction Company for Project W-266A, Water Main Replacement Project in Hilltop in Azusa, San Bernardino Road in West Covina and Los Angeles County, and Workman Avenue in West Covina, in amount not-to-exceed $1,196,541.50.
E-2. Wtr Main Bid Award W-266A
3.
Solicitation of Proposals for Inspection Services for Project W-266A. Recommendation: Approve solicitation of proposals for inspection services for Project W-266A, Water Main Replacement Project in Hilltop in Azusa, San Bernardino Road in West Covina and Los Angeles County, and Workman Avenue in West Covina.
E-3. Wtr Main Insptn Svc
4.
Hsu-Canyon Filtration Plant Engineering Report Contract. Recommendation: Approve the award of contract to Black & Veatch Engineering to prepare the Hsu-Canyon Filtration Plant Engineering Report to the Department of Public Health in amount not-to-exceed $33,000.
E-4. Black-Veatch Award
5.
FARECal Accounting Services Contract. Recommendation: Authorize the Mayor to execute a professional services agreement with Vasquez and Company, LLP to provide accounting services for Financing Authority for Resources Efficiency of California (FARECal), subject to approval by the FARECal Board to reimburse the City of Azusa.
E-5. FARECal Accting Svcs
E-5. Vasquez Proposal
6.
Emergency Purchase Order for MJ Star-Lite Incorporated. Recommendation: Ratify the City Manager's approval of contract and purchase order to perform emergency repair work to construct secondary service conduits at 543-529 Virginia Ann Drive in amount not-to-exceed $34,875.
E-6. Conduit Installation
F.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
1.
Bill Payment Contracts Extension. Recommendation: 1) Approve the extension of contract with Infosend for two years until February 1, 2013 for bill print/mail and electronic bill presentment/payment services; and for Paymentus to process pay-by-phone and web payments; and 2) amend the contract purchase order for Infosend to add $181,000 to cover this period.
F-1. Bill Pay Contracts
2.
Solicitation of Request for Proposals to Evaluate the Azusa Hydroelectric Plant and Conduit. Recommendation: Authorize staff to solicit proposals from qualified consultants to evaluate the condition of the Azusa Hydroelectric Plant and Conduit from an acquisition feasibility standpoint.
F-2. Azusa Hydro Project
F-2. Scope of Work
